compliance_decision:
1. Accountable institutions are required to implement a Risk Management and Compliance Programme (RMCP).
2. The relevant regulatory basis is found in Section 7 of the FIC-Act reference guide, which mandates accountable institutions to adopt an RBA for ML, TF, and PF risks as per guidance set out on a business level, client level, and new products/processes (Section 53).
3. The explanation is that under Section 7 of the FIC-Act reference guide, it's mandated to implement an RMCP which includes conducting risk assessments at various levels as per guidance in section 53 for ML, TF and PF risks within a compliance officer’s jurisdiction.
